title: No Base??
text:
No Base??. I really dislike writing negative reviews, but unfortunately I have to in this case.

I received only the handle...no base. What's worse is that the package that had the handle and base together had very clearly been opened and the handle was shipped in a sealed package. So, I was shipped an incomplete tool. Had the package been torn and the base lost in transit, I would be a lot more understanding.

This very well may be a wonderful tool. I had high hopes. But, with the most important piece of it missing (and in this specific case not even shipped), I have no way to know.

features: For best cooking results, use an indirect method of cooking and position the chicken roaster away from the fire
For use with covered barbecues such as kettle barbecues, gas grills and in the oven
description: Imagine grilling thick cut steaks or slow-smoking a rack of baby backs in the serenity of your favorite grilling spot, using the best grill and barbeque equipment. The dream is now a reality. Rösle grills offer a straight-forward innovative design with functional features that will surely bring a nod of appreciation from those who live to grill. A high and rounded dome for accommodating large chickens and turkeys, handles that are comfortable and stay cool, a solid stainless steel frame that does not fall apart, precise air-flow control vents, stable rubber wheels and best of all, a hinged lid for easy access and safe storage while grilling are just some of the innovative features that will have pit-masters smiling. Rösle grills, for those that expect a grill to work as well as they cook.
